newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Haw Par unit wins S$2.3 mln power deals.
newsitem.headline: Haw Par unit wins S$2.3 mln power deals.

text.p: Scott & English Ltd, a subsidiary of Haw Par Brothers International Ltd, said on Wednesday it had been awarded two contracts worth Singapore $2.3 million to supply generator sets in Indonesia and Taiwan.
The company said in a statement the S$1.1 million Taiwan contract involved providing standby power for phase five of a Taiwan semiconductor wafer plant.
The Indonesian contract, worth S$1.2 million, is to provide power to phase one of the Matahari Batam Centre project.
Separately, Asian Computer Services (ACS), another subsidiary of Haw Par Brothers, said it had been awarded a S$738,000 contract by a Singapore government body.
The contract involves the analysis, development, testing, training, implementation and maintenance of the Human Resource Information System (payroll) for the Housing & Development Board.
